xmldoc.short_description: Shift bits by a given number of places.

param_input_item.param_description: an integer array, or a double array with nonnegative whole values.
the number of places: positive shifts left, negative shifts right. A double or integer array of whole values.
an integer class name used to read a double A (default 'uint64').

param_output_item.param_description: A shifted by k bits, of the same class as A.

description.p: r = bitshift(A, k) shifts the bits of A to the left by k places when k is positive, and to the right when it is negative.
Bits moved past the width of the integer class are lost. A right shift of a signed integer keeps its sign.
When A is a double, the shift is done in assumedtype (uint64 by default) and the result stays double.
A and k must have the same size, or one of them must be a scalar. A single k is accepted only with an integer A; single and logical A are not supported.
